agentInfo.name: three.ws 3D Studio
agentInfo.profileDescription: Turn a text description or reference images into a real, downloadable 3D model for autonomous agents, pay per call. Four quality lanes from a one-cent draft to high detail, one client shape across all of them. Every job returns the GLB file, a browser viewer link, an augmented-reality link that places the model in a real room, and a shareable model page. Job status, the service catalog and live health are free. You pay only when a job is accepted.
